resources.string: Civilian synthetic geospatial viewer with offline reference data
Synthetic example only · No TAK Server, GPS or live intelligence connected

Companion GPT-Doug TAK-GEO supports local GeoJSON and CoT imports, provider metadata and optional USGS imagery after explicit consent. This Android plugin includes an offline synthetic example; it does not automatically download map tiles.

This screen is an illustrative 2D schematic, not an ATAK basemap, navigation aid, operational picture, field tracker or safety instrument. Production use requires authorized build, signing, testing and deployment review.
